name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.68.3: Say why an assetless release cannot be installed; Stop an up-to-date radio reporting the installer as unbuilt.
changelog.v2.68.2: Give the airtime trend a gap the radio's own cadence fits in.
changelog.v2.68.1: Keep the header's assertions spellable from C++; State the name and description limits as characters, not buffers.
changelog.v2.68.0: Give the charts a span picker, a contracting ceiling and one renderer; Pick a chart's ceiling from the readings it draws.
changelog.v2.67.1: Settle the libc branch inside the ioctl header, and make it a helper; Clear every compiler warning the build, the pak and CI emit.
